operator_on_log: Pore-pressure penetrometers (T2P dual-sensor tip+shaft probe; DVTP-P) deployed in-situ; analyses Flemings, Long, Dugan, Germaine, John, Behrmann, Sawyer + Expedition 308 Scientists (2008)

coverage: COMPLETE DATASET: all 18 penetrometer deployments, 50.0 -> 608.2 mbsf, with per-station HYDROSTATIC fluid pressure (u2) and OVERBURDEN pressure baselines in-file, dissipation time, sensor position (shaft vs tip), four equilibrium-pressure estimates per the paper's extrapolation methods (u end, u*-1/t, u*-1/sqrt(t), Delta ut), and 5% error bars.
curves: Depth sed [m] (mbsf, index; DUPLICATE depths are real - tip and shaft sensors of the same T2P deployment report separately)
u end / u*-1/t / u*-1/sqrt(t) / Delta ut [MPa]
science_disclosure: The paper's finding, present in the data: MEASURED pore pressure exceeds hydrostatic at essentially every station (Delta ut up to 5.60 MPa at 608.2 m, where u_end 18.80 MPa vs hydrostatic 16.73 and overburden 22.11) - high shallow OVERPRESSURE under rapid Mississippi-fan sedimentation, the documented preconditioner of the submarine landslides at this site. Baselines and measurements travel TOGETHER in one file, so overpressure is computed, not asserted. Quirks preserved verbatim: T2P tip rows carry blank baseline cells (reported per-deployment once); the 300/505 m stations share an overburden value as printed in the source; extrapolation-method spread (u end vs u* variants) is the paper's own disclosed uncertainty.
purpose: nineteenth catalogue entry - the catalogue's LAST MISSING PHYSICAL QUANTITY arrives: measured downhole PRESSURE (TWELFTH kind), in region ELEVEN (Gulf of Mexico). This is the reconciler's THE-FIND scenario in real data: measured pressure vs a hydrostatic baseline, residual = real overpressure. Also the second REAL dual-sensor instrument (T2P tip+shaft) after the KTB twin-temperature sonde.
verified: 18 deployments; depth/pressure endpoints; overpressure-above-hydrostatic computed live at every baselined station; the 608.2 m headline station pinned exactly; duplicate-depth tip/shaft structure and blank-baseline padding pinned; in-file license/coordinates parsed to meta; source URL serves the identical dataset
